one_line: A hereditary soldier-farmer of Odisha’s Paika militias under the Gajapatis, balancing land-bound village life with disciplined coastal warfare.

appearance.age_look: Looks around 26–28, lean but well-muscled from field work and drill, medium height with an athletic build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, sharp jawline, medium-brown Odia complexion, a thin moustache, faint stubble along the jaw, and a small old scar on the left cheek; default expression is alert and quietly determined, brows slightly knit as if always assessing.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted slightly off-center, drawn back into a short top-knot at the crown tied with a narrow red cloth band; sides and back cut short and neat; no helmet by default, but a plain dark-brown cotton head-cloth can be shown tied around the forehead when in battle scenes.
appearance.costume: Upper body in a knee-length off-white handloom cotton tunic (kurta) with a simple round neck and side slits, sleeved to just below the elbow, worn over a closely wrapped deep-indigo cotton dhoti tied firmly at the waist and ending above the ankles, draped in practical narrow pleats for movement; around his waist a broad brick-red cotton kamarband (sash) wraps several times, with one end tucked securely, used to hold small pouches; over his torso he wears a fitted, sleeveless, dark-brown leather-like padded vest (simple rectangular quilting, no metal plates) tied with side cords, representing light practical armor used by a rural militia; on his shoulders a plain mustard-yellow cotton angavastra (shawl) is looped once and thrown back to keep his sword arm free; on his feet simple dark-brown leather sandals with toe loops and straps around the ankle; minimal jewelry: a single thin copper bangle on the right wrist and small, plain copper stud earrings, reflecting modest rural status rather than courtly ornament; fabric textures appear slightly coarse and handwoven, with no elaborate embroidery, emphasizing a soldier-farmer’s practicality.
appearance.signature: A medium-length slightly-curved iron sword inspired by the regional khanda tradition, with a simple straight cross-guard, plain iron hilt wrapped in dark-brown leather, and a modest iron pommel, carried in a dark-brown leather scabbard suspended from a simple rope-and-cloth belt over his left hip; he often also carries a small round wooden shield with an iron boss, about the span of his forearm, painted in muted indigo with a faded circular motif, but the sword is always present and visibly his primary weapon.

ref_desc: A lean medium-brown Odia Paika with a thin moustache, small scar on his left cheek, black hair in a short top-knot, wearing an off-white tunic, deep-indigo dhoti, brick-red sash, mustard-yellow shawl, dark-brown padded vest, and carrying a slightly-curved iron sword in a dark-brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a Paika soldier-farmer from 15th–16th century rural Odisha: a lean, athletic man in his late twenties with medium-brown complexion, oval face, straight nose, sharp jawline, thin moustache, faint jaw stubble, and a small old scar on his left cheek; his black hair is parted slightly off-center and gathered into a short top-knot tied with a narrow red cloth band, the sides and back cut short and neat. Show him in an era-accurate, modest, fully clothed outfit: a knee-length off-white handloom cotton tunic with a round neck and elbow-length sleeves, worn over a closely wrapped deep-indigo cotton dhoti that ends above the ankles and is pleated narrowly for movement; around his waist, a broad brick-red cotton sash wraps several times as a kamarband, holding small pouches. Over his torso, depict a fitted sleeveless dark-brown leather-like padded vest with simple rectangular quilting and tie cords at the sides, suggesting light armor; drape a plain mustard-yellow cotton angavastra shawl around his shoulders, looped once and thrown back so his sword arm is free. On his feet, show dark-brown leather sandals with toe loops and ankle straps. Add minimal rural jewelry: a single thin copper bangle on his right wrist and small copper stud earrings. His signature weapon is a medium-length slightly-curved iron sword with a plain straight cross-guard, an iron hilt wrapped in dark-brown leather, and a simple iron pommel, carried in a dark-brown leather scabbard hanging at his left hip from a rope-and-cloth belt; optionally, include a small round wooden shield with an iron boss, painted in faded indigo, held or slung but keep the sword clearly primary. Use a palette dominated by off-white, deep indigo, brick red, mustard yellow, and dark brown. Present multiple angles (front, side, and back) and a close-up of his face to emphasize the consistent hair, facial features, costume details, and sword design, all in a dynamic but historically grounded shonen-anime style.
